reviews.text:
We adopted our puppy from this shop a few years ago! I stopped by recently to buy some treats, and the staff were all so kind, remembering us and saying things like "You've grown so big!" which made me very happy 🌷
My puppy seemed happy too, and I think he remembers being loved so much since he was little 😊✨
Since then, whenever we pass by the shop, my puppy wants to go in and stops in front of it (lol).
I think it's a wonderful pet shop! I'd like to keep coming back 🩷
very good staff and deeply caring toward pets.

I always rely on this shop whenever I buy treats or pet supplies.

The staff are incredibly kind and gentle, and they always dote on my dog. My dog ​​loves seeing the staff so much that she wants to go into the shop every time we go for a walk! 🐶✨

This shop is a cherished haven not only for my dog, but for many other dogs and their owners. It's a warm and welcoming pet shop where you can feel the deep love the staff has for animals!

I hope to continue being a customer for many years to come. ☺️

Every time I pass by on my dog ​​walk, I'm soothed by the adorable puppies and kitties.

I appreciate their style of letting them all play freely without keeping them in individual cages. The shop is clean, they have a wide variety of food, and above all, the staff are all kind and gentle. Even though my dog ​​wasn't adopted from here, everyone is so affectionate towards him that he always wants to go inside to get attention from the ladies. It seems like all my other dog-owning friends also find themselves stopping by here often.

I always use this pet shop for boarding and buying treats✨ The staff are all very kind and their love for animals is evident, making it a reassuring pet shop♡ It's a place of relaxation for my dog-loving friends in the neighborhood, and the staff play with the dogs with so much love that they all want to go in and don't want to leave! The store is clean and has a wide variety of products, making it a really great shop♡

I adopted two cats from this shop.

The second cat had a fungal infection, so they kept her at the pet shop until she was fully recovered, and I was supposed to pick her up then.

I received a call that the fungal infection had cleared up a little earlier than expected, and I picked her up about a week later.

The day before I was supposed to pick her up, she had loose stools, and I was told it would be best to wait a few days, but since their customer service had been poor since I adopted my first cat, I told them it was okay and I wanted to pick her up, and I did so the next day.

During that phone call, they said they would "give her the usual diarrhea medicine," and I felt that they were just giving her medicine based on their own judgment without even taking her to a vet, even though there was a possibility of parasites, which is one of the reasons I picked her up the next day.

Even when they explained the contract for the second cat, it felt rather perfunctory, perhaps because I had already adopted the first one.

I experienced this both when I adopted my first and second cats, but the staff's private conversations were truly awful.

Despite me listening to the important information about the cat I was going to adopt, the staff member kept talking about things unrelated to work.

They were speaking loudly enough for everyone in the store to hear.

When I entered the store, the staff member who greeted me was still polite, but the staff member in the back room who had removed their mask and was talking, had pierced ears and made eye contact with me but didn't say a word, and had a sullen attitude.

I realized that despite other people's reviews mentioning this issue and the store responding with promises to improve, it seems they haven't changed.

I felt like all the staff members were still stuck in a student mindset.

They didn't look that age, though.

First of all, despite working in a job that involves selling and managing small cats and dogs, they were wearing a lot of keychains on their pants and earrings. I was appalled that they were wearing earrings and keychains, even though if they fell off and were accidentally swallowed by a cat or dog, it could have a terrible effect. Regarding the earrings, I remember she was wearing quite a few, not just one.

It might be allowed by company regulations, but I don't think earrings or keychains are "absolutely impossible to fall off."

I think it's obvious if you think about it for a moment.

The second cat was long-haired, and I noticed after bringing it home that it had a tangled mat of fur that wouldn't come off.

I wondered if they were brushing it properly.

The staff working there didn't seem like the kind of people you'd expect to find in a store dealing with animals, so while the cats and dogs aren't to blame, I honestly can't recommend it.

I contacted the head office, but they said they would check with the store, which made me lose faith in them, so I decided to write this here.

I hope no one else has to go through this unpleasant experience.
Oppose the sale of live organisms!

My dog ​​has a sensitive stomach, so I was looking for dog food that would suit him. A staff member approached me and gave me helpful advice, which I really appreciated. I've visited several times, and the staff are all so kind, talking to my dog ​​and showing him affection. My dog ​​loves the store and the staff so much that he always wants to go in whenever we pass by! Even on busy days, they greet me with a smile, which I really appreciate.

It's such a lively and cheerful store that I'd love to visit again.

I live nearby and have used this store several times to buy food for my cat, but every time the female staff have had a really bad attitude.

They're constantly chatting amongst themselves about things unrelated to work, which makes me feel uncomfortable.

Even though I'm a customer, they're loudly saying things like, "I wish I could have worn a yukata," and talking about work-related matters while ringing up purchases. I've seen other reviews, and it seems everyone is complaining about the staff's private conversations, so why don't they fix it?

Also, the area around the register is incredibly dusty. If they're going to chat so much, why don't they clean it up?

I stop by to buy snacks once every few months.

However, even on those occasional visits, the staff are always unfriendly, and I wonder how they manage to stay in business...

My wife had a bad experience in the past (twice) where the salesperson was chatting with other staff members the entire time she was making a purchase, so I don't buy anything there anymore. I just avoid the store (lol).

Also, I stopped by at the beginning of July. The store smelled strongly of urine. Is their hygiene management okay?

I bought the snacks and left quickly. The customer I overheard talking to the staff about a contract looked quite uncomfortable.

Thank you very much for visiting us. We are also very pleased to receive your high rating. We will continue to strive to improve our services so that everyone can use them with peace of mind. We look forward to your next visit.

Pet Shop Inu no Ie & Neko no Sato Staff

The staff here are incredibly rude.
First of all, when you enter the store,
they don't even say "Welcome," they're just chatting amongst themselves.
They're using foul language and just making a lot of noise.
It wasn't just once.
It was like that both times, so I can't imagine getting a pet here.
I bought two or three treats for my pet, but
they're all gone now.

I've used this store before,
and since my cat has grown, I brought him with me.

I met another wonderful cat there and decided to adopt a new one.

The male staff member, like the last time, was very thorough and explained everything to me.

There were several female staff members,
and at first,
nothing particularly happened,
but when I brought my cat in, he wouldn't stop crying and kept saying things like, "Oh, he doesn't like it,"
which made me feel a little uncomfortable.

I didn't feel any respect for the customers,
and they didn't follow up with us at all,
just said things like, "He'll have diarrhea tomorrow" from the register.
You guys are able to do your job thanks to these cats, so shouldn't you give him some support?

It bothered me.
The service was very good last time,
so I used this store again,
but now I realize that this is the kind of store it is,
so I won't be going back.

But the cat is a very well-behaved boy and is doing well.
I'm grateful, at least, for giving me this opportunity to meet him.

I'm not a cat rescuer so I can't really say for sure, but I'm posting this in the hope that people will think about how each and every word and action is perceived, and that even in busy situations and daily lives, they will remember that they are treating lives as a business.
The store that arranged for Ruru-chan. The person in charge back then is no longer with us, but the staff are all very kind ^_^

We previously adopted a Pomchi from them.

It was our first dog, and the staff explained everything clearly and thoroughly, including how to care for the dog and insurance, which was a great help. Our Pomchi is still growing up to be a healthy and gentle dog! I'm so glad that Inu no Ie Shinjuku was the first place we adopted a dog from, as they helped us find our perfect companion. We would like to adopt our second dog from Inu no Ie Shinjuku as well.

I requested the shampoo course. I was very satisfied with the previous grooming course, so I asked for this one with confidence. However, this time the hair around my dog's right eye was cut too deep and turned white. I understand that dogs get fussy during the cut, but they just sent it back without any explanation. I was still concerned, so I asked again that evening and was told that "it's just how it is." I have attached photos from the previous grooming, so please take a look.

I'm not asking for anything special, and I don't want to argue over 9,000 yen, but I think the most important thing is that my dog ​​is cleaned and not injured. This has made me worried about whether I can leave my dog ​​with them again next time.
The staff always work hard with smiles on their faces ✨

I visited for the first time to adopt a kitten!

The shop was clean, there were no unpleasant smells, and the animals seemed to be in a good environment.
I fell in love at first sight with a very energetic and affectionate little girl.
I took her home that same day!

The staff spent 3-4 hours carefully explaining everything, from how to care for the cat to insurance options, and even looked up the nearest vet to my house.
Before I left the kitten, they did a physical check and even gave her a shower, so she was in a clean condition when I received her.

The staff even sent me some photos they had taken via AirDrop and gave me several printed copies!
As I was leaving, the staff came to the door and told me to come again anytime.
I did a lot of research before going to this pet shop, but I'm so glad I chose this one for my first visit!

I'll definitely use them again! ✨
